title: Council framing
description: Output of the facilitator's opening job: the question as the members will answer it. Every member sees it at every stage; it is not a contribution.

question.description: One answerable question, neutral between the possible answers.

constraints.description: Limits every option must respect: the ones the council was given, and those you found in the repo or knowledge base, with where each comes from.

must_contain.description: What the decision must settle to be usable, e.g. which store, the migration path, who is affected.

context.description: Facts members should start from, each with its source: relevant code, ADRs, knowledge entries, earlier jobs.
